map.eGFR 和肌酐哪个准？: Which is more accurate, eGFR or creatinine?
map.血肌酐受肌肉量、饮食影响；eGFR 用公式校正年龄性别更接近真实肾功能，是 CK: Serum creatinine is affected by muscle mass and diet; eGFR corrects age/sex by formula, closer to true kidney function, and is the main basis for CKD staging and medication, but still needs cystatin C, urine protein, etc.
map.单位搞错会怎样？: What if the unit is wrong?
map.该工具血肌酐按 µmol/L 输入（÷88.4 转 mg/dL）；egfr-ca: This tool takes serum creatinine in µmol/L (÷88.4 to mg/dL); the egfr-calculator version takes mg/dL; the two versions differ in unit, a wrong fill gives ~88x error, be sure to check the unit.
